entries.description: Verified pre-existing security-dashboard-uat-checklist.json covers all seven dashboard tabs, shell/access, tab strip, and cross-cutting quality with 40 items across 10 functional areas, including explicit seeded test data (admin@acmecoffee.com, jdoe@acmecoffee.com, james.smith@example.com, entity/control/endpoint names) per the lessons-learned UAT-data rule.

Validated checklist JSON against uat-checklist-editor checklist-schema.json using jsonschema.validate. No errors. 40 items conform to ProjectName/Review structure with required FunctionalArea/Subarea/ItemLabel.

Build: 1 warning, 0 errors. Test: 627 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests.WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates expects docs/workflow-auth-observability.md which was deleted in commit 8730107 during repository cleanup). Failure unrelated to this session; flagging for the human as a pre-existing fixture/test-data drift.
Independent cross-provider verification via gemini-pro. See session-reviews/session-1-review-1.md for raw output.

Addressed all 4 verifier issues (1 Major, 3 Minor). Cross-referenced SeedData.cs and security-config.json to ensure user-role mappings and endpoint list are accurate. Checklist now has 42 items across 10 FunctionalAreas with open-feedback rows in every area.
Round-2 cross-provider verification via gemini-pro. See session-reviews/session-001-review-002.md for raw output.
